novelty.justification: The claim’s novelty route is the proposed mechanism that “correctness of a given problem depends causally on which latent pivot language the model transits” and that this pivot can be selected per problem through hidden-state steering. Searches around “multilingual LLM internal reasoning language logit lens activation steering,” “latent pivot language chain-of-thought,” and “problem-dependent language switching reasoning” identify very close foundations: Do Multilingual LLMs Think In English? (2025) already uses logit-lens evidence for English-like internal representations and compares language-specific steering vectors; Language-Specific Latent Process Hinders Cross-Lingual Performance (2025) applies logit lenses and latent steering to multilingual reasoning; and The Impact of Language Mixing on Bilingual LLM Reasoning (2025) predicts when language switches help and guides reasoning accordingly. Moving to a token-by-token latent-language trajectory and hypothesizing different beneficial non-English pivots by problem category is a non-trivial but natural integration and operationalization of those results, rather than a new core paradigm or wholly unexpected relationship.
